title: UneceGeographicalObjectCharacteristic
description: An attribute of a geographical object.

description.description: The textual description for this geographical object characteristic.

descriptionReference.description: The description reference, expressed as text, for this geographical object characteristic.

geometryCollectionIndicator.description: The indication of whether or not this geographical object can be characterized as a geometry collection.

identifier.description: The identifier for this geographical object characteristic.

name.description: The name, expressed as text, for this geographical object characteristic.

physicalIndicator.description: The indication of whether or not this geographical object can be characterized as physical.

relevantGeometryType.description: The type of geometry, expressed as text, relevant for this geographical object characteristic.

shapeType.description: The type of shape, expressed as text, such as a semi-circle, for this geographical object characteristic.
